subject: SurfaceForms onsite capture — schema & privacy handoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@scanly.co>, Barcelona Summit Ops <ops@bcn-summit.org>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00+01:00
Subject: SurfaceForms onsite capture — schema & privacy handoff

Hi Sarah / BCN ops team,

Thanks again for confirming the booth slot. We're finalizing the data handoff for SurfaceForms (badge + QR fallback) for the Barcelona Summit next week. Quick checklist and asks so engineering and ops can align: 

- Schema: can you confirm the CSV schema you will emit at EOD each day? I attached a draft (schema_draft.csv). We need: first_name, last_name, email_hash (SHA256), phone, company, job_title, opt_in_status, source_channel, scan_timestamp.
- Consent language: we need the exact text that attendees see on the scanner screen and the QR form. We're leaning on an explicit opt-in checkbox for marketing; privacy will be handled by our HS form.
- HubSpot / Salesforce mapping: we will ingest to HubSpot as primary and push agreed records to Salesforce during nightly sync. Please confirm if you can send a unique external_id for dedupe (recommended). 
- Rate/volume: expected 5–8k scans/day — confirm CSV batch sizes and retry behavior.

Can you review the attached schema and the sample API spec we asked for earlier? If you can confirm the field names and whether you can emit email_hash instead of raw email (preferred), we can send a HubSpot mapping and consent snippet tomorrow.

Timing: we need final confirmation by EOD 2026-11-12 to schedule the ingestion test on 2026-11-14 02:00–04:00 UTC.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +44 20 5555 0102

Attachments: schema_draft.csv

Subject: Re: SurfaceForms onsite capture — schema & privacy handoff

Thanks Jonas — quick answers inline.

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 09:15 Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah / BCN ops team,
> 
> Thanks again for confirming the booth slot. We're finalizing the data handoff for SurfaceForms (badge + QR fallback) for the Barcelona Summit next week. Quick checklist and asks so engineering and ops can align: 
> 
> - Schema: can you confirm the CSV schema you will emit at EOD each day? I attached a draft (schema_draft.csv). We need: first_name, last_name, email_hash (SHA256), phone, company, job_title, opt_in_status, source_channel, scan_timestamp.

We can emit a daily CSV and also push a secure S3 PUT with the same schema. We will emit email_hash (SHA256) by default; raw_email is available only if you provide an encrypted transfer key. Sample CSV header we will produce: first_name,last_name,company,job_title,phone,email_hash,source_channel,device_id,scan_timestamp,opt_in_status,external_id

> - Consent language: we need the exact text that attendees see on the scanner screen and the QR form. We're leaning on an explicit opt-in checkbox for marketing; privacy will be handled by our HS form.

We recommend the following short line for the scanner: "I agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference and partner sponsors. See [privacy link]." For QR fallback we can show the same line and force a checkbox. We will provide a screenshot of the scanner UI by EOD.

> - HubSpot / Salesforce mapping: we will ingest to HubSpot as primary and push agreed records to Salesforce during nightly sync. Please confirm if you can send a unique external_id for dedupe (recommended). 

We will include an external_id (UUID) per scan. Regarding phone number formatting, we will provide E.164 if attendees enter country code; otherwise we'll provide raw.

> - Rate/volume: expected 5–8k scans/day — confirm CSV batch sizes and retry behavior.

CSV sizes are fine; we'll rotate files every 6 hours and backfill with retries for failed uploads for up to 24 hours.

We attached our API spec for the scanner and a short note about encryption options (scanly_api_specs.pdf). Let me know if you want us to deliver raw email for a short window during test ingest; otherwise we will only provide email_hash.

—Sarah
Sarah Lopez
Head of Integrations | Scanly Events
sarah@scanly.co

Attachments: scanly_api_specs.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@scanly.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: SurfaceForms onsite capture — schema & privacy handoff

Thanks Sarah — this is perfect. Quick follow-ups and the mapping we will use: 

- Consent snippet (scanner + QR): we will use an explicit opt-in checkbox with the following wording on both surfaces: "I consent to receive marketing communications from Redwood Inference and selected partners. View privacy policy: https://redwood.com/privacy". Store the checkbox value in opt_in_status with values: "consented" / "declined".
- HubSpot mapping (high level):
  - first_name -> contact.firstname
  - last_name -> contact.lastname
  - email_hash -> contact.hs_email_hash (custom property)
  - phone -> contact.phone
  - company -> company.name (create company record if none)
  - job_title -> contact.jobtitle
  - source_channel -> contact.lead_source (value: "Barcelona Summit - SurfaceForms")
  - external_id -> contact.external_id

Marissa — can you review the mapping above and the consent wording? I attached a more formal mapping sheet (hs_field_mapping.xlsx) and a short list of consent snippets (consent_snippets.txt). For the test window on 2026-11-14 02:00–04:00 UTC, we will request raw emails for match-back only during a 30-minute test window and immediately delete raw email after one hour; otherwise ingestion will be hashes only. Sarah, please confirm you can support a 30-minute raw-email push on the test and then revert to hash-only.

Jonas

> On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 14:02 Sarah Lopez <sarah@scanly.co> wrote:
> > Thanks Jonas — quick answers inline.
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

All good from my side — two small edits: 

1) Change contact.lead_source to a picklist value we control: "Event: Barcelona Summit — SurfaceForms" (so reports don't fragment).
2) For Salesforce, we want the email_hash stored on Contact as a custom text field and set a nightly job to push HubSpot contact ID -> SF Contact.External_Id. I'll leave the SF implementation details to the apps team, but please add the SF mapping column to hs_field_mapping.xlsx.

Marissa — please own test run coordination with Scanly and confirm whether we can accept raw email for a 30-minute window; if you approve, Jonas, please coordinate credentials and S3 path with Sarah.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
